blocks.md: - Straight, branched and cyclic organic molecules are also called **aliphatic **compounds as long as they do not contain a **benzene ring**
- **Straight-chain **organic molecules are those in which the carbon atoms are connected to each other in one continuous chain

blocks.alt: Structural formula of butane, showing a linear chain of four carbon atoms single-bonded with ten hydrogen atoms in total.
blocks.caption: Pentane is a straight-chain organic molecule as the carbon atoms are connected in a straight line

blocks.md: - **Branched **organic molecules have side groups attached to the main chain of carbon atoms

blocks.alt: Structural formula of 2,3-dimethylbutane, showing six carbon atoms bonded with hydrogen atoms in a branched configuration.
blocks.caption: 2-methylbutane is a branched organic molecule as the main chain (consisting of 4 carbon atoms) has a methyl branch

blocks.md: - **Cyclic **organic molecules are those in which the carbon atoms are connected to each other in a ring shape

blocks.alt: Chemical structure diagram of cyclohexane, featuring a hexagonal ring of carbon atoms, each bonded to two hydrogen atoms.
blocks.caption: Cyclopentane is a cyclic organic molecule as the carbons are attached to each other in a ring structure
